claim.claim-text: 1. An upper (302) for an article of footwear (300) comprising:

a knit component (110) forming at least a surface of the upper (302), wherein the knit component (110) comprises a first surface (111) and a second surface (112) and one or more yarns (113, 114) extending between the first surface (111) and the second surface (112), the one or more yarns (113, 114) forming at least part of one or more of the first surface (111) and the second surface (112).
2. The upper (302) of claim 1, wherein the knit component (110) further comprises an area that comprises a polymer component (303-306).
3. The upper (302) of claim 2, wherein the area forms at least part of a forefoot area of the upper.

4. The upper (302) of claim 3, wherein the forefoot area comprises a fusible yarn (114) comprising a fusible material, particularly wherein the fusible material in the forefoot area is fused with non-fusible material of a non-fusible yarn (113) in the forefoot area.
5. The upper (302) of any one of claims 3 to 4, wherein the forefoot area of the upper (302) comprises a plurality of layers.
6. The upper (302) of any one of claims 3 to 5, wherein the polymer component (303-306) forms a polymer layer in the forefoot area.
7. The upper (302) of any one of claims 3 to 6, wherein the polymer component (303-306) is at least one selected from a polymer sheet and a polymer foam.

8. The upper (302) of any one of claims 2 to 7, wherein the area is reinforced by the polymer component (303-306) and wherein the polymer component (303-306) is absent from a second area of the upper (302).
9. The upper (302) of any one of claims 2 to 8, further comprising a second polymer (303-306) component in a heel region of the upper (302).

10. The upper (302) of claim 9, wherein the second polymer component (303-306) extends between a medial side of the upper and a lateral side of the upper (302), or wherein the second polymer component (303-306) is secured to an exterior surface of the upper (302).

11. The upper (302) of claim 9 or 10, wherein the second polymer component (303-306) is secured to an interior surface of the upper (302), and/or wherein the second polymer component (303-306) is at least one selected from a polymer sheet and a polymer foam.
12. The upper (302) of any one of claims 4 to 11, wherein the fusible yarn (114) comprises fusible filaments.
13. The upper (302) of any one of claims 1 to 12, wherein the upper is incorporated into an article of footwear (300).

a sole (301); and an upper (302) secured to the sole (301), the upper (302) comprising: a knit component (110) forming at least a surface of the upper (302), wherein the knit component (110) comprises a first surface (111) and a second surface (112) and one or more yarns (113, 114) extending between the first surface (111) and the second surface (112), the one or more yarns (113, 114) forming at least part of one or more of the first surface (111) and the second surface (112).

15. The article of footwear (300) of claim 14, wherein the knit component (110) further comprises an area forming at least part of a forefoot area of the upper (302), the area comprising a polymer component (303-306).

16. The article of footwear (300) of claim 15, wherein the forefoot area comprises a fusible yarn (114) comprising a fusible material that is fused with non-fusible yarn (113) comprising a non-fusible material, and/or wherein the polymer component (303-306) is absent from a second area of the upper (302).
